events.title: The Card That Almost Got Away

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A card slips from the counter just as you step into the shop. Jicy catches it before it reaches the floor, then turns toward you with a bright, welcoming smile.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: There! No bent corners. Are you looking for something in particular? I can help, if you'd like.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'm still figuring out which deck to start with. I don't want to get in anyone's way.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: You wouldn't. I can show you a few beginner-friendly options. I'm Jicy, by the way. I should probably introduce myself before I start giving directions.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: As she talks, Jicy rocks gently from side to side. A second card tips from the counter and she makes a quick little hop to catch it. Her fitted suit follows the motion with a small bounce at her chest and hips; you notice for a moment, then meet her eyes again.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You have quick reflexes. Thanks for making this easier.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I like helping! I mean, I really do. And... I'm glad you came in today.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Your smile leaves Jicy quiet for a beat. Color rises in her cheeks, and she quickly points you toward the decks before she can lose her nerve completely.

choices.label: Ask her to help you compare the starter decks
choices.reply: Jicy brightens at once. She takes her time explaining each option and seems pleased that you trust her advice.

choices.label: Tell her that her enthusiasm is contagious
choices.reply: Jicy sways, then gives a tiny excited hop. “That's a very nice thing to say. I might remember it all week.”

choices.label: Say you were glad to meet her, too
choices.reply: Jicy blushes and tries to answer smoothly. “Me too. I mean—yes. I'm glad too.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy has saved a quiet table and brought a few deck ideas she thought you might enjoy. She looks pleased when you join her, then immediately begins to worry that she planned too much.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I brought a couple of possible lists. You don't have to use any of them! I just remembered what you said you liked.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You remembered that already? That's thoughtful.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I remember little things when they matter to me. Sorry. That sounded more intense than I meant.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She rocks softly from side to side while you compare cards. When you praise one of her suggestions, she gives a quick, delighted hop in her seat and laughs at herself.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I think this combination feels like me.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: It does! And I like hearing you talk about the cards you love. Would you want to do this again sometime? We could talk about cards, or about anything else.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'd like that.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Good. I was hoping you'd say yes. I mean, I hoped you'd have a nice afternoon either way.

choices.label: Ask her to make this a regular deck-building afternoon
choices.reply: Jicy smiles so broadly that she has to look down at the cards for a second. “I'd love that.”

choices.label: Thank her for remembering what you like
choices.reply: “Of course,” Jicy says, then admits she has been trying not to make it obvious how much she enjoys your company.

choices.label: Call it a date, if she wants it to be
choices.reply: Jicy's eyes widen. She takes one tiny hop, then answers with a shy smile: “I would like that. A lot.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy finds you in the library with a book open beside her. She has chosen a seat with room for both of you and a stack of trading-card histories to share.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I thought we could read for a while. You don't have to talk if you don't feel like it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You don't mind sitting quietly together?

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Not at all. I like being with you, even when nothing special is happening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy sways gently while she reads, occasionally looking up as if she has something to say. She starts a sentence twice, then settles for a small smile.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You can tell me. You don't have to make it perfect.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I get nervous when I care about how a conversation goes. Sometimes my feet start moving before I've decided what to say.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I like hearing what you want to say, even if it comes out a little messy.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Thank you. I like your company. I wanted to say that without turning it into an offer to do something for you.

choices.label: Tell her you enjoy quiet time with her, too
choices.reply: Jicy's shoulders relax. She returns to the page, still smiling whenever she thinks you aren't looking.

choices.label: Ask what she wants to do when she isn't helping someone
choices.reply: Jicy thinks carefully, then says she'd like to keep reading beside you. It feels like a real answer.

choices.label: Tell her you like being someone she chooses to spend time with
choices.reply: Jicy blushes and gives one tiny hop. “I do choose it. I just need to get used to saying that out loud.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy invites you to the park to test a few new card ideas. A light breeze scatters several cards across the bench before either of you can set up.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Oh! I'll get them. Sorry, I can be a little too eager.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She makes two quick, springy hops and gathers the cards before they can slide away. When she comes back, she is grinning and just a little out of breath.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You move quickly when you get excited.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I know. I sway when I'm trying to stay still, then I jump when I forget to stay still. It's a little silly.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It makes you easy to read—in a good way.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I was going to tell you that I look forward to seeing you. I do. Every time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy sways once, takes a small breath, and looks directly at you instead of down at the cards.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I'm not ready to explain everything I feel yet. But I'm trying to be braver about letting you know that I care.

choices.label: Tell her she can take her time
choices.reply: Jicy nods, visibly relieved. “Thank you. I want to be honest with you, not rush myself.”

choices.label: Say you look forward to seeing her, too
choices.reply: She makes a happy little hop, then laughs and reaches for the cards. “Okay. I can be brave for another minute.”

choices.label: Ask if she'd like to plan an afternoon just for the two of you
choices.reply: Jicy's smile turns shy but certain. “Yes. I would really like that.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy asks you to meet at the café after the evening rush. She has a note folded in her hand, though she keeps checking whether she can say the words without it.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I wrote down what I wanted to tell you. Then I tried to memorize it. Then I decided I should just talk to you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You don't need a perfect speech. I'm listening.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: The first time I saw you, I wanted to keep talking to you. I thought you were kind, and I got this silly little flutter whenever you smiled at me.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I kept finding reasons to help because it gave me a chance to be near you. I know I don't have to earn someone's time by being useful. I just... really like you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her hands tremble around the note. She rocks once from side to side, makes a tiny hop, and finally meets your eyes.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Would you like to go on a date with me? If you don't feel the same, I still want us to be kind to each other.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That took courage. Thank you for telling me.

choices.label: Tell her you like her, too, and accept the date
choices.reply: Jicy lets out a relieved laugh, then makes a delighted hop. “Okay. A real date. I can do that. I think I can.”

choices.label: Tell her you care about her and want to take things slowly
choices.reply: Jicy smiles with a little more confidence. “Slow is good. We can keep choosing this one step at a time.”

choices.label: Tell her you value her deeply as a friend
choices.reply: Jicy looks a little shy, but her smile stays warm. “Thank you for being honest. I still want to be your friend.”

imageSequence.moment: Jicy arrives with her folded note and begins the conversation.
She steadies herself, admits how she feels, and finally meets the player's eyes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy is choosing between two books when she spots you in the library. She smiles and holds up a small paper bookmark.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Do you have a favorite kind of story? I keep meaning to read more outside my usual picks.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Something with an adventure and a satisfying ending.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: That sounds lovely. I like knowing the characters make it somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She rocks gently from side to side while she thinks, then offers you the bookmark with a hopeful smile.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you sure I can keep it?

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Yes. Then when you find a good ending, you can tell me about it.

choices.label: Promise to tell her what you think of the book
choices.reply: Jicy smiles. “I'll look forward to the review. No pressure to finish it quickly.”

choices.label: Ask her to read the first chapter with you
choices.reply: She gives a tiny hop and pulls up a chair. “I was hoping you'd say that.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy stands in front of an arcade game, watching the score counter with intense concentration.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you trying to beat your own record?

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I was! Then I thought it might be more fun if we took turns.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She makes a quick hop as the game starts, then laughs at herself and settles into a focused stance.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You were more excited than the machine.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She laughs and turns to celebrate a close round, but catches her foot on the edge of the floor mat. She pitches forward and braces herself with both hands beside you.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Oh! I'm sorry—are you okay? I didn't mean to land right on you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'm fine. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She searches your face, then sees your gentle smile. The worry in her shoulders eases. Instead of springing away, she takes a breath and stays close.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I thought I'd be embarrassed enough to run off. But... I feel safe with you. Can I stay here for a second?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Of course. Take all the time you need.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Thank you. I think I can try that next game now. Maybe standing up first.

choices.label: Tell her to take her time
choices.reply: Jicy nods, visibly relieved. “Thank you. I'm glad I don't have to rush away.”

choices.label: Suggest a friendly rematch together
choices.reply: Her smile returns. “A rematch sounds good. But this time I'll watch my feet.”

choices.label: Tell her you feel safe with her, too
choices.reply: Jicy's blush deepens, but she holds your gaze. “I'm really glad you told me that.”

imageSequence.moment: Jicy accidentally stumbles forward and braces herself beside the player, immediately checking if they are okay.
The stumble turns into a close, sweet moment as Jicy lands above the player.
Seeing the player's reassuring smile, Jicy relaxes and lets herself stay close.
Jicy sees the player's gentle smile and realizes she feels safe staying close.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy has a trading card on the café table, studying its illustration between sips of tea.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I know this card isn't rare, but I love the tiny details in the background.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The artist hid a little symbol near the tree.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I never noticed that! You found it so quickly.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What else do you see?

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: A whole story, I think. Maybe the character is on the way home.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy smiles at the card, then at you. For once, she doesn't rush to fill the quiet.

choices.label: Invent the next part of the card's story together
choices.reply: Jicy adds a happy ending and asks if you can continue it another day.

choices.label: Tell her you like seeing what she notices
choices.reply: She blushes, then gently nudges the card toward you. “I like sharing it with you.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy is sitting on a park bench, looking up at the clouds. She makes room for you with a warm smile.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: That one looks like a tiny dragon. Or maybe a very surprised dog.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I can see both now.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Good. I was worried my imagination was doing all the work.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She sways slowly as the two of you trade guesses, then gives a tiny hop when you spot a new shape.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You make even sitting still look energetic.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I think I like sitting still more when I'm with you.

choices.label: Stay until the clouds change
choices.reply: Jicy leans back and smiles. “That sounds like a perfect plan.”

choices.label: Ask her to save the best cloud for your next walk
choices.reply: She gives you a hopeful smile. “I'd really like there to be a next walk.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy is organizing a few cards at the shop counter. When she sees you, she gently sets them aside and waves.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: I finally found the card I was looking for. It was right here, under my notes.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: So the search is over?

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Yes! I know it's a tiny thing, but I've been looking for it all week.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She does a quick, happy hop, then laughs at her own celebration.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Small wins still count.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: They count more when you get to tell someone who understands.

choices.label: Celebrate with her
choices.reply: Jicy beams. “Thank you for treating my tiny victory like it matters.”

choices.label: Ask her to tell you the story behind the card
choices.reply: She tells you every detail, delighted that you want to hear it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The tournament hall is already buzzing when you arrive with Jicy. She turns toward you with a delighted smile, eager to take it all in.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: There are so many tables! I want to see every match. Come on, let's look around!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jicy turns to take in the rows of players and cards, glancing back at you as if to make sure you are sharing the view.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: That table has a close game, and that one looks exciting too! How are we supposed to choose?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She plants her feet in an exaggeratedly wide stance and points toward the crowd with both arms, practically vibrating with enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You look like you're about to race to all the tables at once.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Maybe I am! I just don't want to miss anything. Oh—there's an open seat. Want to watch me play?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: When a seat opens, Jicy settles across from another tournament player and lays out her deck, still smiling at the busy room.

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: A friendly match is the perfect way to enjoy the tournament. Ready?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Absolutely. Good luck!

lines.speaker: jicy
lines.text: Thanks! I'm going to have fun either way.

choices.label: Cheer her on through the match
choices.reply: Jicy glances up with a bright grin, then turns back to her cards, energized by your support.

choices.label: Ask her to explain her favorite play afterward
choices.reply: “Deal!” Jicy says. She is already collecting a few ideas she can't wait to share with you.
